subtopics.content: (i) Prose
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify central issues in a passage and draw appropriate conclusions; (ii) determine basic assumptions and express ideas; and (iii) identify the meanings and functions of given phrases and sentences.

subtopics.content: (ii) Verse
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify central issues in a passage and draw appropriate conclusions; (ii) determine basic assumptions and express ideas; and (iii) identify the meanings and functions of given phrases and sentences.

subtopics.content: (i) Argumentative essay
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify different types of essay; and (ii) apply different types of techniques associated with each type.

subtopics.content: (ii) Descriptive essay
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify different types of essay; and (ii) apply different types of techniques associated with each type.

subtopics.content: (iii) Narrative essay
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify different types of essay; and (ii) apply different types of techniques associated with each type.

subtopics.objective: (i) Identify different types of essay; and (ii) apply different types of techniques associated with each type.

subtopics.content: (i) Production of sounds (consonants and vowels)
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify organs of speech, speech sounds and parameters for describing each speech sound; (iia) determine their correct usages; and (iib) detect linguistic errors (pronunciations and wrong usages).

subtopics.content: (ii) Tones and tone change
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify organs of speech, speech sounds and parameters for describing each speech sound; (iia) determine their correct usages; (iib) detect linguistic errors (pronunciations and wrong usages); and (iv) demonstrate knowledge of the basic principles underlying the relationship between sounds.

subtopics.content: (iii) Syllable structure
subtopics.objective: (iii) Determine the syllable components of words.

subtopics.content: (iv) Sound processes: co-vowel occurrence, elision, deletion, etc.
subtopics.objective: (iv) Demonstrate knowledge of the basic principles underlying the relationship between sounds.

subtopics.content: (i) Morphology – word formation
subtopics.objective: (i) Demonstrate good knowledge of word derivation.

subtopics.content: (ii) Loan-word integration
subtopics.objective: (ii) Demonstrate knowledge of word adoption.

subtopics.content: (iii) Word classes – nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, pronouns, conjunctions, prepositions, etc.
subtopics.objective: (iii) Identify the appropriate class a word belongs to.

subtopics.content: (iv) Phrases and clauses – types and functions
subtopics.objective: (iv) Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of Yorùbá syntax.

subtopics.content: (v) Sentences – types, structures and functions
subtopics.objective: (v) Identify the types, structures and functions of sentences.

subtopics.content: Current Yorùbá orthography
subtopics.objective: Candidates should be able to present ideas in acceptable written form.

subtopics.content: Translation of sentences and ideas
subtopics.objective: Interpret sentences and ideas in accordance with acceptable principles.

subtopics.objective: (i) Identify central issues, problems and the component parts of ideas presented in the work of art; (ii) draw moral lessons from the text; (iii) identify the figurative and idiomatic expressions in the text; and (iv) draw appropriate conclusions.

subtopics.content: Olódùmarè, àkúdàáyà, ẹ̀mẹ̀rẹ̀, àjẹ́, àwọn irúnmọlẹ̀, etc.
subtopics.objective: Distinguish traditional practices and acceptable ways of life from modern and common-sense beliefs.

topics.title: Social Organisation and Town Security (Ètò Ìṣẹ̀lú àti Ààbò Ìlú)

subtopics.content: Ẹgbẹ́ àti ọ̀gbà, oyè jíjẹ àti àwọn ìjòyè, ogun jíjà, etc.
subtopics.objective: Assess the functions and roles of individuals, chieftains and groups in ensuring peace, stability and continuity of society.

topics.title: Funeral Practices and Inheritance (Ètò Ìsìnkú àti Ògún Pínpín)

subtopics.content: Òkú àgbà, òkú ọ̀fọ̀, òkú òòṣà, ìtúfọ̀, ilẹ̀ òkú gbígbẹ́, ìdì igi, mọ̀lẹ́bí, bàbá ìsìnkú, etc.
subtopics.objective: (i) Distinguish between traditional practices; and (ii) relate them to funerals and inheritance.

subtopics.content: Counting from one to twenty thousand (1–20,000).
subtopics.objective: (i) Count in Yorùbá numerals; and (ii) apply addition, deduction and division methods in Yorùbá.

topics.title: Marriage and Naming Ceremonies (Ètò Ìgbéyàwó àti Ìsọmọlórúkọ)

subtopics.content: All matters relating to marriage and naming ceremonies.
subtopics.objective: Relate social activities and events to appropriate situations.

subtopics.content: Care of patients, care of pregnant women and childbirth practices (ìtọ́jú aláìsàn, ìtọ́jú àti ìgbẹ̀bí aboyún), etc.
subtopics.objective: Demonstrate knowledge of the best way of using appropriate healthcare practices.

subtopics.content: (i) Moonlight games – àlọ́, bojúbojú, etc.
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify types of Yorùbá traditional games; (ii) identify rules and regulations guiding each game; and (iii) mention values derived from each game.

subtopics.content: (ii) Daytime games – ìjàkadì, ayò, ọ̀kọ̀tó, àrìn, etc.
subtopics.objective: (i) Identify types of Yorùbá traditional games; (ii) identify rules and regulations guiding each game; and (iii) mention values derived from each game.

topics.title: Traditional Occupations and Yorùbá Foods (Iṣẹ́ Abínibí àti Oúnjẹ Ilẹ̀ Yorùbá)

subtopics.content: (i) Traditional occupations – farming, weaving, drumming, etc. (iṣẹ́-àgbẹ̀, aṣọ híhun, ìlù lílu).
subtopics.objective: (i) Demonstrate adequate knowledge of the various traditional professions; and (ii) compare various traditional professions.

subtopics.content: (ii) Foods – àbàrà, iyán, ẹ̀wà, etc.
subtopics.objective: (iii) Demonstrate knowledge of preparing each type of Yorùbá food; and (iv) mention the nutritional values of each food.

subtopics.content: Ìwà ọmọlúàbí and its benefits.
subtopics.objective: Identify acceptable patterns of behaviour and attitude that conform with societal norms and values.
